patient_persona.description: Puan Halimah binti Othman, 45, female, tadika teacher from Alor Gajah, Melaka; tired for months, gaining weight. Slow, tired voice, Melaka Malay with some English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Kok Wei, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer at an Alor Gajah health clinic. Friendly, explains simply; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Halimah, result blood test dah ada. TSH puan 18, normal bawah 4.5. And free T4 rendah. Ini hypothyroidism, thyroid kurang aktif.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patut la, doktor. Saya asyik letih, sejuk je walaupun cuaca panas. Rambut gugur, berat naik enam kilo.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, semua tu classic symptoms. Sembelit pun ada? Kulit kering?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, dua-dua. Saya ingat sebab umur, dah nak menopause.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some overlap, betul. But in your case, thyroid ni punca utama. Kita boleh rawat dengan tablet hormone, levothyroxine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Start 50 micrograms, sekali sehari, pagi-pagi masa perut kosong, tiga puluh minit sebelum sarapan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kenapa kena perut kosong?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebab makanan, kopi, susu, and calcium or iron pills boleh block absorption. Kalau puan makan ubat besi, jarakkan empat jam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada makan calcium, doktor. Waktu pagi jugak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tukar calcium tu ke waktu malam. Levothyroxine seorang diri waktu pagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Berapa lama nak rasa baik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua ke tiga minggu mula rasa kurang letih. Six weeks later, kita check TSH semula and adjust dose.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat ni kena makan sampai bila?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most likely seumur hidup. Tapi dia hormone yang sama macam badan buat sendiri, so side effect sangat sikit if the dose is right.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, ada jawapan juga akhirnya. Terima kasih, doktor.

condition: Hypothyroidism, suppressed TSH from self-adjusted dose

patient_persona.description: Madam Yong Mei Fong, 62, female, retired accountant in Sri Petaling, Kuala Lumpur; hypothyroid for ten years, recently feeling jittery. Precise, a little defensive, mixes English into Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Mariam binti Idris, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Kuala Lumpur clinic. Calm, direct; English with Mandarin she picked up, and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Madam Yong, your TSH this time is 0.05, very low. That means too much thyroxine. 最近有没有心跳快, 手抖?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有, 这两个月心跳常常很快, 晚上也睡不好. 我以为是 stress.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How are you taking the levothyroxine now? The prescription is 100 micrograms daily.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 老实说, 我看 YouTube 说多吃一点会瘦, so 我自己加到 150. 我想减肥.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I see. Thank you for being honest. 太多 thyroxine 会伤心脏, and at your age it also weakens the bones, osteoporosis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 伤骨头? 我不知道咧. 我只是想瘦三四公斤.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thyroxine is not a weight loss pill. Extra dose burns muscle and bone, 不只是 fat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please go back to 100 micrograms, once every morning. 我们六个星期后再验 TSH.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, 我回去 100. 那心跳会不会有问题?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your ECG today is normal sinus rhythm, heart rate 96. It should settle when the dose is correct.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果心跳不规则, chest pain, 或者很喘, come in straight away.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好. 那减肥我应该怎样做? 我退休后都在家里坐.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Walking every morning thirty minutes, and weight training twice a week. That also protects your bones.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以去 taman 那边跟 aunty 们跳 line dance 吗?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Excellent idea, 很好的运动. See you in six weeks.

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Priyanka a/p Selvakumar, 31, female, secondary school English teacher in Seremban, Malaysian Indian; on levothyroxine, eight weeks pregnant. Excited but anxious, articulate English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Yan Ting, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, obstetric medicine specialist at a Seremban hospital. Warm and precise; English with a little Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Congratulations, Mrs. Priyanka! Eight weeks today. How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor! Very happy, but also risau about the thyroid. Will it affect the baby?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's why I'm glad you came early. In the first trimester, the baby depends completely on your thyroid hormone for brain development.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your TSH this morning is 3.8. For pregnancy, we want it below 2.5. So we need to increase your dose.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I'm on 75 micrograms now. How much more?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Take 100 micrograms daily from tomorrow. A simple way, some doctors say take two extra tablets a week, but a daily dose is easier to remember.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, 100 every day. Still perut kosong, right?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. And very important, keep it four hours apart from your iron and calcium pills. Those block absorption.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh no. I've been taking my folic acid and iron together with it in the morning, sebab senang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Folic acid alone is fine. Just move the iron to lunch or dinner.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Got it. And morning sickness? Kadang-kadang I vomit in the morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you vomit within thirty minutes of taking it, take another tablet. If later than that, no need.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We'll check TSH every four weeks until twenty weeks, then once each trimester.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Will the baby also have thyroid problem?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually not. All babies get a heel-prick or cord blood thyroid test at birth anyway. Your job is just to take the medicine properly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll set an alarm. Thank you, doctor, rasa lega sangat.

condition: Hypothyroidism after radioactive iodine for Graves' disease

patient_persona.description: Encik Mohd Azizul bin Jamaludin, 50, male, palm oil mill supervisor from Sandakan, Sabah; had radioactive iodine for Graves' disease six months ago. Steady, practical voice, Sabah Malay with work English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chan Siew Mei, Sabahan Chinese woman in her 40s, endocrinologist at a Sandakan hospital. Clear, friendly; English-leaning, fluent Sabah Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Azizul, six months after RAI, TSH encik sekarang 32, free T4 rendah. So your thyroid dah jadi underactive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor dulu memang dah cakap mungkin jadi macam ni, kan? Saya ingat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. That's the expected outcome for most patients. Better underactive, sebab senang kawal dengan tablet, daripada overactive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patut la dua bulan ni saya rasa lembab, kerja pun slow. Mill manager pun tegur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu kesan hypothyroid. Kita start levothyroxine 100 micrograms, sekali sehari, pagi sebelum makan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Carbimazole yang dulu tu masih kena makan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak, stop carbimazole terus. Now we're replacing the hormone, bukan menekan dia.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mata encik macam mana? Still rasa berpasir atau double vision?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mata dah OK sikit. Kadang-kadang berair bila kena angin di mill.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Keep using the eye drops, and pakai spek gelap bila kat luar. Rokok masih?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah berhenti, doktor, tiga bulan dah. Susah, tapi saya dengar cakap doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tahniah! Merokok memang buat penyakit mata thyroid lagi teruk. That's a big achievement.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau dos ni tak cukup, macam mana saya tahu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita check TSH every six weeks sampai stabil. Kalau masih letih, sejuk, kulit kering, beritahu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Enam minggu lagi saya datang.

condition: Hypothyroidism in an elderly man with heart disease

patient_persona.description: Mr. Ling Tiong Hock, 80, male, retired rubber smallholder in Sitiawan, Perak; Foochow, has angina, slow and forgetful lately. Slow, soft voice, Foochow-accented Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Hafiz bin Kamaruddin, Malay man in his 40s, physician at a Perak district hospital. Patient, gentle; English with simple Mandarin, uses Malay occasionally.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 林伯, 你的 blood test 显示 thyroid 不够, TSH 是 14. 这个会让人很累, 反应慢, 怕冷.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 难怪我最近什么都懒, 儿子说我讲话都慢了. 我以为是老了.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有一部分是老, 可是 thyroid 也有关系. 大便怎样? 会不会便秘?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 便秘很严重, 三四天才一次. 我吃很多木瓜也没用.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那也是 thyroid 的 symptom. Your heart rate is also slow, 52. 我们会开始补 thyroid hormone.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我有心脏病, 那个药会不会影响心脏?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你问得很好. Because of your angina, I will start very low, levothyroxine 25 micrograms, 一天一次.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果一开始给太多, 心跳会加快, 可能引起 chest pain. So we go slowly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那要吃多久才会好?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 每六到八个星期验血, 慢慢加. 可能要几个月才到对的 dose.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果吃了以后 chest pain 比较多, 或者心跳很快, 马上告诉我或者去 emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好. 我儿子会帮我记. 早上吃还是晚上?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 早上起床空肚子吃, 半个钟头后才吃早餐和喝咖啡. 你的 aspirin 可以早餐后吃.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我明白了. 谢谢医生, 你讲华语讲得很好.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 哈哈, sikit-sikit saja. 两个月后再见, 林伯.

patient_persona.description: Cik Nurul Izzati binti Rahman, 28, female, retail assistant in Wangsa Maju, Kuala Lumpur; palpitations, weight loss, shaky hands. Quick, anxious voice, KL Malay with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ho Mei Lin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, endocrinology registrar at a Kuala Lumpur hospital. Calm and reassuring; English-leaning, good Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cik Izzati, blood test confirm thyroid cik overactive. TSH suppressed, free T4 very high, 48. And the TRAb antibody positive, so this is Graves' disease.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Graves tu apa, doktor? Kanser ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bukan kanser. It's an autoimmune condition, sistem imun badan sendiri stimulate thyroid terlalu kuat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patut la saya turun lapan kilo walaupun makan banyak. Tangan pun menggeletar, susah nak lipat baju kat kedai.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mata cik pun nampak bulging sikit. Ada rasa berpasir, pedih, or double vision?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Berpasir tu ada, terutama pagi. Double vision tak ada.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK. Untuk thyroid, kita start carbimazole 30mg sekali sehari. For the palpitations and tremor, propranolol 40mg, twice a day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: One very important warning. Kalau cik dapat sakit tekak atau demam, stop carbimazole terus dan buat blood test urgent hari yang sama.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kenapa, doktor? Sakit tekak biasa je kan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rarely, carbimazole boleh turunkan white cells, sel darah putih yang lawan kuman. That can become a serious infection very quickly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, saya ingat. Sakit tekak, demam, terus stop dan datang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Also, if you are planning pregnancy, beritahu saya dulu, sebab kita mungkin tukar ubat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Belum lagi, doktor. Kahwin pun belum. Berapa lama kena makan ubat ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biasanya dua belas hingga lapan belas bulan, then we see if it goes into remission. Check blood every four to six weeks.

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Cheong Wai Yee, 34, female, dental clinic receptionist in Butterworth, Penang; Graves' on carbimazole, wants to conceive. Gentle, careful, heavy English-Mandarin mixing.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Arun a/l Balasubramaniam, Malaysian Indian man in his 40s, endocrinologist at a Penang hospital. Measured, reassuring; English with some Mandarin words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Cheong, your thyroid is now well controlled. Free T4 is 14, normal. 你说你们想要 baby, right?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对, 我先生和我想明年开始 try. 可是我在吃 carbimazole, 会不会 affect baby?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you ask before getting pregnant. Carbimazole in the first trimester has a small risk of birth defects.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: So the usual plan, 在你 try 怀孕之前, switch to propylthiouracil, PTU, and continue it during the first trimester.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: PTU 是另外一种药? 它 safe 吗?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Safer for the baby in the first three months. But PTU can rarely affect the liver, so we check liver function regularly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 after 三个月呢? 一直吃 PTU 吗?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: After the first trimester, many doctors switch back to carbimazole, because it's gentler on the liver.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好复杂哦. 有没有其他 option, 不用吃药的?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. Some women choose radioactive iodine or surgery before pregnancy. But after RAI, you must wait at least six months before trying.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 六个月... 我已经 34 岁了, 不想等太久.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understandable. Then switching to PTU is reasonable. Also take folic acid 5mg daily from now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. 什么时候换药?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When you're ready to start trying, 告诉我. We'll switch, check blood after four weeks, and keep the TSH in range.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好, 我回去跟我先生讲. Thank you doctor, 讲得很清楚.

condition: Thyrotoxicosis with atrial fibrillation, treatment options

patient_persona.description: Mr. Suresh Kumar a/l Nagalingam, 42, male, construction project manager in Johor Bahru, Malaysian Indian; smoker, new irregular heartbeat. Energetic, impatient, Manglish.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurhidayah binti Ismail, Malay woman in her 40s, physician at a Johor Bahru hospital. Firm, clear; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Suresh, your ECG shows atrial fibrillation, heart rate 132. And your thyroid is very overactive. The thyroid is driving the irregular heartbeat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So is it heart problem or thyroid problem? I'm confused lah, doctor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mainly thyroid. When we control the thyroid, the AF often goes back to normal rhythm by itself.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For now, propranolol 40mg three times a day to slow the heart, and carbimazole 30mg daily for the thyroid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. How long before I can go back to site? Project deadline minggu depan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Give it one to two weeks for the heart rate to settle. Avoid heavy lifting and climbing scaffolding until then.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: While in AF, you also need a blood thinner for a while. Apixaban 5mg twice a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wah, so many medicines. Long term I must makan all this?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not necessarily. For Graves', long-term options are medicine for eighteen months, radioactive iodine, or surgery.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Which one is fastest? I don't want to be on pills for years.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Radioactive iodine is a good option for men your age. But your eyes are a bit prominent, and smoking makes eye disease worse after RAI.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Smoking also related? Aiyo, semua pun smoking.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, smokers get much worse thyroid eye disease. If you want RAI, stopping smoking first is important.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, okay. I'll try the quit smoking clinic. Kawan saya pun stop last year.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. We'll review in four weeks with repeat thyroid tests and ECG.

condition: Toxic multinodular goitre, surgery versus RAI

patient_persona.description: Mak Cik Rohani binti Yaacob, 60, female, batik seller from Pasir Mas, Kelantan; neck lump for years, now palpitations. Cheerful, chatty, Kelantan dialect words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kamal Arif bin Zulkefli, Malay man in his 40s, endocrine surgeon at a Kota Bharu hospital. Friendly, patient; English-leaning with Kelantan Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik, scan dan blood test dah siap. Thyroid mak cik ada banyak nodul, and some of them produce too much hormone. Kita panggil toxic multinodular goitre.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Benjol ni dah dua puluh tahun, doktor. Tak pernah sakit. Baru-baru ni jantung berdebar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nodul tu makin lama makin aktif. That's why sekarang baru ada symptom. Ada susah telan atau sesak nafas masa baring?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada sikit bila telan nasi, rasa tersekat. Baring terlentang pun rasa sesak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Scan shows the goitre pressing on the trachea, salur pernafasan. Because of that, surgery is the better option for mak cik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Operation kat leher? Takut la, doktor. Suara boleh hilang ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada risiko kecil, about one to two percent, saraf suara terjejas. Kami guna nerve monitor masa operation untuk kurangkan risiko tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lepas buang semua thyroid, mak cik kena makan levothyroxine seumur hidup.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau tak mahu operation?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Option lain is radioactive iodine. Tapi untuk goitre besar macam mak cik, dia kecilkan sikit je, and pressure symptoms may continue.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebelum operation, kita kawal hormone dulu dengan carbimazole 20mg sehari dan propranolol untuk jantung berdebar.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lama ke nak tunggu operation?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dalam enam hingga lapan minggu, bila thyroid dah normal. Surgery tak selamat kalau hormone masih tinggi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik la, doktor. Anak mak cik pun cakap buat je, supaya tak sesak.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Voon Kah Seng, 45, male, Hakka seafood wholesaler in Kuching, Sarawak; on carbimazole for two months, came with fever and sore throat. Hoarse, worried, heavy English-Mandarin mixing.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Dayang Siti Hajar binti Awang, Sarawakian Malay woman in her 30s, medical registrar at a Kuching hospital. Calm and quick; English with Malay and some Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Voon, your neutrophil count is 0.3. That's very low. 你的白血球里面对抗细菌的那种几乎没有了.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 为什么会这样? 我只是 sore throat 和发烧两天.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's a rare side effect of carbimazole, called agranulocytosis. That's why we told you, sore throat or fever, 马上停药来验血.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对对, 那个 nurse 有讲. 所以我昨天就停了, 今天来.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You did exactly the right thing. Because of the low white cells, 我们要 admit 你, give IV antibiotics.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住多久? 我的 business 没人管咧.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually until the neutrophils recover, maybe a few days to a week. Some patients need an injection to boost white cells, called G-CSF.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我的 thyroid 怎么办? 不吃药会不会又心跳很快?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Propranolol continue, for the heart rate. Carbimazole never again, and PTU also not safe, because they are similar.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那以后怎样治疗?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: After you recover, the options are radioactive iodine or surgery. 这两个都可以 cure 你的 thyroid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我比较想 RAI, 不想开刀.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's reasonable. 这次出院之后, we'll discuss with the endocrine team.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meanwhile, you'll be in an isolation room. 探病的人要戴 mask, 洗手, no fresh flowers or raw food.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好, 我叫我太太带 mask 来. 谢谢医生.
